lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hey there, friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's here!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The time we've been waiting for is finally here!
What is that?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The group of Raptures that I've been following

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: has been in incredibly high spirits lately.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: They must have caught a fair amount of prey recently.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Either way, they shouldn't care if a new Rapture joins the group now!
So now's a perfect time to observe them?
So now's a perfect time to join the herd?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Precisely!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: These are the coordinates they've been congregating at.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: They've been going there to rest and repair any damaged parts.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Once we get there, all we have to do is

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: keep a low profile and blend in as we observe them.
All right.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh, yes...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Is it possible for your Nikke friends

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: to keep their distance?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Nikkes and Raptures don't exactly get along, after all.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Their presence may agitate the Raptures,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: and we may end up on the receiving end of that aggression.
I'll have them observe from a distance.
I'll make sure they understand the situation.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's not a bad idea!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you at the rendezvous point.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Come meet me there in your Raptocamo.
